rules: Validate internal Items state before cross-save validation.
Require character-scoped owners to exist in authoritative Character state.
Require NPC and merchant owners to exist in authoritative subsystem state.
Require quest_id and event_id metadata references to exist when projected.
Require active corpse subjects, loot owners, and limited-item reservation owners to resolve.
Reject ambiguous missing ownership; do not silently delete, move, or recreate items.
native_boundary: Native commit sequencing, journals, and exact recovery ordering remain deferred to the final DLL/WCC/WBB pass.
